description:
Generate a 1-click Telegram bot deep link (https://t.me/<bot>?start=sub_<token>) pre-loaded with search filters so a user can confirm instant Telegram notifications for new matching apartments or secondhand items in one tap.
<hints>
- Call this whenever a user asks to be notified / set up an alert / monitor new listings matching their search filters, or after a search returns few/no matches.
- Pass the exact same filter fields used in search_real_estate or search_classified_items (requires at least one filter beyond city, such as query, category, deal_type, district, rooms, or max_price).
- Returns telegram_url (direct Telegram deep link), redirect_url, normalized criteria, and a human-readable prompt summary. Always share telegram_url directly as a clickable link.
</hints>

bbox.description: Map bounding box: 'min_lng,min_lat,max_lng,max_lat' or [min_lng, min_lat, max_lng, max_lat]

canonical_product.description: Canonical product model name for classifieds (e.g. 'iPhone 15 Pro')

currency.description: Currency ('USD' for real estate, 'GEL' or 'USD' for classifieds)

district.description: District name or comma-separated list (e.g. 'Old Batumi,Rustaveli')

no_summer_increase.description: Fixed year-round rental price without summer hike

subscription_type.description: Optional explicit type ('property' or 'classifieds'). Auto-inferred from filter fields if omitted.

name: create_telegram_alert
